{"id": "4b3014e9-ded0-4138-992f-1b71d7704429", "role": "assistant", "content": [{"text": "Based on AWS Elemental MediaTailor documentation, here's how `PersonalizationThresholdSeconds` works:

**What happens when exceeded:**
`PersonalizationThresholdSeconds` sets the maximum duration of underfilled ad time (in seconds) allowed in an ad break. If the ad decision server can't fill enough of the break and the underfilled time exceeds this threshold, MediaTailor **abandons personalization of that ad break entirely** and falls back to showing the underlying (original) content instead.

**Precondition for it to apply:**
This threshold only applies to **ad replacement**, not ad insertion. It's only meaningful in live and VOD streams where ads are being swapped in over existing underlying content — since the fallback behavior depends on having that underlying content stream to show. If there's no underlying content (pure ad insertion scenario), the threshold doesn't apply.", "type": "text"}], "created_at": null}
